name: Lending

subjectOf.text: DeFi platforms grant the unbanked access to the loan market by disintermediating existing banks, connecting borrowers and lenders directly in peer to peer networks and accepting digital assets as collateral with far less documentation than banks require.
subjectOf.abstract: DeFi platforms grant the unbanked access to the loan market by disintermediating existing banks. DeFi Dapps connect borrowers and lenders in peer-to-peer networks directly.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Digital Asset Market Evolution (2020). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3606663
scope_conditions: borrowers excluded from centralized banking for lack of documentation

subjectOf.text: Every type of economic action becomes more efficient when decisions are hedged, because hedging lets participants confidently change investments and keeps the market liquid, and lending and insurance therefore require someone to underwrite the risk.
subjectOf.abstract: Every type of economic action is made more efficient when decisions are hedged, so we can confidently change our investments, keeping the market liquid. Lending and insurance are essential catalysts for business, that require someone to underwrite the risk.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Eight Institutions for the Evolution of Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782205

subjectOf.text: Member default on premia is a major inefficiency in chit funds, with estimates that a large share of subscribers have defaulted at least once recently and a substantial share have defaulted after winning an auction.
